genesis.overlay.label: Genesis - Preview World
genesis.overlay.tooltip: Open the Genesis preview to see this seed's biomes before you create the world.
genesis.screen.title: GENESIS
genesis.screen.banner: G E N E S I S
genesis.screen.back.tip: Close the preview and go back to the world creation screen.
genesis.screen.seed.tip: The seed the preview draws; type or paste one, then press Random or Create World.
genesis.screen.random.tip: Roll a new random seed and preview it.
genesis.screen.copy.tip: Copy the seed shown above to your clipboard.
genesis.zoom.near.tip: Zoom the map in to the closest view.
genesis.zoom.mid.tip: Zoom the map to the middle view.
genesis.zoom.far.tip: Zoom the map out to the far view.
genesis.screen.export.tip: Save the map in view as an image with x and z coordinates to your screenshots folder.
genesis.zoom.wide.tip: Zoom the map out to the widest view, one pixel per chunk.
genesis.screen.spawn.reset.tip: Forget the chosen spawn point and let the world pick its own.
genesis.structure.toggle.tip: Show or hide where structures can start, worked out from the seed.
genesis.map.title: Genesis World Map
genesis.map.banner: W O R L D   M A P
genesis.map.close.tip: Close the map and go back to the game.
genesis.map.center.tip: Move the map back to where you stand.
genesis.map.unavailable: The world map needs singleplayer, or a server running Genesis with its world map on.
genesis.screen.unavailable: Preview not available for this world type.
genesis.screen.failed: The preview could not start. The game log says why.
genesis.approximate.fallback: Approximate: the world type could not be sampled directly, so some biomes come from a simpler lookup. The game log says why.
genesis.approximate.climate: Approximate: this world type has its own generator, so biomes are placed by vanilla climate.
genesis.approximate.biolith: Approximate: Biolith's biome replacements could not be read, so where it replaces a biome this map shows the biome it replaces.
genesis.approximate.biolith_sub: Approximate: where Biolith places a sub-biome in the world, this map shows the biome around it.
genesis.approximate.missing: Approximate: biomes a mod adds could not be placed on this map. The game log says why.
biome.genesis.unreadable: Could not be read (see game log)
genesis.screen.create.tip: Create the world with the seed and settings shown here.
genesis.screen.pregen.tip: Choose how much of the world to generate before you enter it.
genesis.pregen.radius.tip: How many chunks out from spawn to generate before you enter the world.
genesis.pregen.threads.tip: How many threads pre-generation may use, from 1 to 16.
genesis.pregen.start.tip: Create the world and generate the chosen radius before you enter it.
genesis.pregen.title: PRE-GENERATING WORLD
genesis.pregen.cancel.tip: Stop pre-generating and close this screen.
genesis.pregen.pause.tip: Pause pre-generation, or resume it when it is paused.
genesis.pregen.enter.tip: Enter the world now and keep pre-generating in the background.
